explanation: Count values with Counter and select its k most common keys. Counting preserves every occurrence and selection returns the uniquely defined top-k membership.
timeComplexity: O(n + u log(k+1)) expected upper bound for n values and u distinct values; selecting every key may sort all u keys.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Python algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
